description: Starter asset pack for a 30-second anime-style Three.js montage. All assets are CC0 1.0, CC-BY 3.0, or SIL Open Font License 1.1.
note: Restyle models with toon/cel shaders. Recolor the van or school bus as a yellow danfo with black stripes; recolor the motorcycle as a glowing electric okada. Build anything missing procedurally.
